summary: This bill requires federal agencies to report annually on primary care spending under federal health care programs and establishes a working group to study and recommend ways to prioritize and improve primary care.

scores.thoughts: This bill focuses entirely on primary care within federal healthcare programs, aiming to increase spending, accessibility, and quality. This directly impacts the structure and emphasis of public healthcare provisions, pushing towards a more robust public primary care system.

The bill requires annual federal reports on primary care spending across all federal health programs and creates an HHS working group to recommend ways to prioritize primary care spending, increase provider access, and improve service quality in federal programs (including rural areas). This is entirely government-directed data collection and policy study within public programs, aligning with the government-action side of the spectrum.
